# rixl_feed_stats (Data Source)

Fetches performance, subscriber, and engagement metrics for a content feed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feed_id` (String)

### Optional

- `rangeend` (String) The range.end query parameter.
- `rangestart` (String) The range.start query parameter.

### Read-Only

- `avg_time_per_visit_ms` (Number)
- `total_posts` (String)
- `total_views` (String)
- `total_watch_time_ms` (Number)
- `unique_viewers` (String)
